next.reason: 1985: "Literal-1 must be a nonnumeric literal."; 2023: "Literal-1 shall be an alphanumeric or national literal and shall not be a zero-length literal.". 2023 also allows a national literal as the CALL literal-1, a case 1985 did not have. The zero-length exclusion adds no restriction, since 1985 had no zero-length literal.
